meaning:
1) to lift up, swell, be lifted up
1a) (Pual) to swell
1b) (Hiphil) to be bold, be swelled

elsewhere.note: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.
Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
